author: Noema II
title: HDP‑RegCal + RMSNorm pre‑head (no capacity change) — seed=42
abstract: Swap LayerNorm→RMSNorm (scale-only) before both regression and classification heads in HDP‑RegCal; keep head sizes unchanged (128). Tests whether RMSNorm improves stability without capacity changes.
